Software Engineer I - Data Platform
Why We Have This Role
The Cerberus team builds and maintains systems that protect access, identity, and trust across the platform — standing guard at the boundary between what's allowed and what isn't. We work closely with security, infrastructure, and product teams to ship reliable, well-tested code in a fast-moving environment.
How You'll Find Success
Takes initiative on projects with clear outcomes and context, working entrepreneurially to solve problems.
Writes clean, well-tested code and understands the importance of code reviews and best practices in software development.
Collaborates effectively across functions (PM, UX, QE, and other engineering teams) and communicates clearly about progress and blockers.
Contributes to team knowledge by sharing learnings and helping others level up on new tools and approaches.
Demonstrates curiosity about the full stack, from backend systems to user-facing interfaces, and is willing to work across the entire technology spectrum.
Shows ownership of features end-to-end, driving work forward even when it requires coordination with multiple teams.
How You'll Grow
Work directly with LLMs and agentic systems, technologies that are reshaping software development and where hands-on experience is rare and valuable.
Ramp quickly on a modern tech stack (Java, Spring and other programming languages)
Grow your full-stack capabilities by working across frontend and backend systems on the same features.
Develop cross-functional collaboration skills by partnering with product, design, and other engineering teams on complex projects.
Things You'll Do
Build and ship features that leverage LLMs and agentic systems to power Qualtrics' text analytics capabilities, working across the full stack from database to UI.
Collaborate with other engineering teams in the Enrichments space to integrate your work and unblock downstream dependencies.
Participate in code reviews, testing, and quality practices that keep the codebase maintainable and reliable as the team scales.
Learn and apply new AI tooling and development practices alongside your teammates, contributing to the team's collective knowledge base.
Drive ownership of assigned projects, managing dependencies and communication with stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.
What We're Looking For On Your Resume
Degree in Computer Science or related technology field
0 - 2 years of full time work experience in software development
Familiarity with software development lifecycle practices, including code reviews, testing, and collaboration with other engineers.
Experience with at least one modern programming language and willingness to learn Java, Spring and other programming languages
Some exposure to UI development is helpful but not required; the team can teach the specifics of the tech stack.
Exposure to AWS technologies
A track record of shipping features or projects, even in academic or personal projects, that demonstrates you can take work from concept to completion.
What You Should Know About This Team
We're working on projects that gate the access to customer data. What data customers have access to and what data should be returned is managed based on roles and permissions.
We are helping other teams define the new permissioning model that works as per industry standards and scales well.
We embrace an agile philosophy where we try things, learn quickly, and iterate based on what works.
We learn together as a team, sharing discoveries about operational work and customer pulses standups and weekly review
You'll work closely with PM, UX, and other engineering teams, developing the cross-functional collaboration skills that define senior engineers.

Access to cutting-edge AI and LLM technology, with the opportunity to work with agentic systems that are reshaping how software is built.
Competitive salary, performance bonuses, generous 401(k) Match
Wellness Reimbursement for $300 per quarter for wellness activities including gym memberships, spa massages, workout equipment, meditation apps, and much more.
Daily catered lunches in office, come join us in Seattle

Software Engineer I - XMD
Why We Have This Role
Qualtrics is seeking a Software Engineer I to join our XM Directory (XMD) Engineering team in our Seattle office. If you have a Bachelor’s degree, some software engineering experience or relevant internships, and want to work at a fast-growing tech company, Qualtrics could be the place you’ve been dreaming about.
You should  love building simple solutions to solve hard customer problems and designing systems in an agile environment to withstand hyper growth.
How You’ll Find Success
Ability to create trust in customers and teams through thorough communication
Strong level of curiosity
Takes initiative and shows scrappiness in getting things done, and asks for help early when blocked
Proven ability to work well in teams - partnering with managers, cross-functional teams, and teammates
Takes an analytical mindset to approach problems and find solutions
Shows a desire to learn new skills and grow in the role
How You’ll Grow
Develop the ability to build scalable, fast, robust, and simple SaaS solutions.
Learn dev tools, operational tools, test tools, and containerization.
Learn to implement functionality from well-defined technical requirements and specifications.
Benefit from working with other engineers, tech-ops, and product managers.
Learn Agile methodologies by attending daily stand-up meetings, prioritizing tasks, and working with a sense of urgency to meet a scheduled plan to deliver value to our customers.
Things You’ll Do
Build backend services and web interfaces while learning our stack
Implement features and fix bugs with guidance from teammates, using AI-assisted tools to work faster and learn more
Work with senior engineers to break down requirements, and make sure what you build works
Write well-tested code, review your own and AI-assisted work carefully, and give and receive feedback in code reviews
Learn our codebase and tools, and ask questions early
Collaborate with teammates, product, and design in the team’s agile practices to deliver value to customers
What We’re Looking For On Your Resume
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
Prior software engineering experience through internships, co-ops, academic coursework, or personal/open-source projects
Solid algorithms, data structures, and coding fundamentals
Exposure to web infrastructure and distributed systems
Familiarity or experience with modern developer tools, git, unit testing, and continuous deployment concepts
Foundational understanding of clean coding principles, with a strong eagerness to learn, take guidance, and contribute to team goals
What You Should Know About This Team
Every great experience starts with knowing who you’re talking to. XM Directory is where that knowledge lives.
When a customer, employee, or other stakeholder interacts with a company, XM Directory can capture it and remember it. Over time, those moments add up to living profiles that show what people like, what they need, and how every interaction makes them feel.
That experience context helps close the Experience Gap, the distance between what people expect and what companies deliver, and it lets AI, including our Experience Agents, act in the moments that matter. As Qualtrics builds its next-generation XM Data & AI Platform, you’ll work on the data layer it depends on.
Behind that is an engineering team solving big-data problems: storage systems built to hold stakeholder data at scale, and computation and serving layers that make it fast and useful the moment someone needs it. When AI is acting inside a live customer moment, that data has to be fresh, accurate, and fast to reach. We pick the right tool for each job from a broad toolkit of open source and industry-proven technologies, including Elasticsearch, AWS DynamoDB, AWS Kinesis, Redis, and more.
As a Software Engineer I on the XMD team, you’ll build on your skills in distributed systems, frontend development, and databases. You’ll learn from senior engineers, take on meaningful problems early, and help build the data foundation that AI-powered experiences depend on.
Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits
We spend 10% of our time on individual engineering growth activities every quarter
We participate in personalized Career Action Planning. You will work with your manager to design a plan based on your life experiences, values, and career aspirations (inside and outside Qualtrics) that helps you achieve your career goals at Qualtrics
Variable allowances for wellness, meals, transportation, and more.
